title: When the Protocol Turns
premise: Mara Lockridge, a xenolinguist turned cargo hauler, discovers the nine-second gravity flicker was a handshake from an ancient orbital intelligence that has been preserving two cryosleep arks: one holding Earth's last generation of dreamers, one holding the colony that abandoned them. The Protocol governing the system demands she choose which ark wakes before Earth's final transmission loop decays forever. Haunted by memories that are no longer entirely her own — her dead mother's voice woven into the alien signal — Mara ultimately refuses the binary choice, teaching the Protocol to wake both arks in staggered waves, sacrificing her own cryosleep slot and remaining behind as the living bridge between humanity's halves.
about_author: Wendell Pemberton is a former radio astronomer who spent a decade calibrating deep-space listening arrays before turning to fiction full-time. He writes from a converted observatory on the Atlantic coast, where he insists the best stories arrive between transmissions.

chapters.title: Nine Seconds of Falling
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Hauling ore through contested orbits, Mara experiences the system-wide gravity flicker — nine seconds where everything floats, including her own grief. Her ship's AI logs an impossible signal embedded in the event. Emotional beat: dislocation; the world she trusted briefly stopped holding her.

chapters.title: The Language She Lost
chapters.summary: Mara's POV, with flashbacks to her linguistics career. She realizes she no longer dreams in any human language — her dreams have been replaced by structured pulses she almost understands. A black-market broker offers passage to the derelict relay station at the flicker's epicenter. Beat: hunger for meaning over safety.

chapters.title: Contested Orbit
chapters.summary: Dual POV: Mara and Colonel Adeyemi, whose patrol fleet is hunting whoever triggered the flicker. Their ships nearly collide; he lets her go, suspicious but intrigued by her decoding of the pulse fragments. Beat: wary connection across duty lines — love against duty seeded early.

chapters.title: The Relay Remembers
chapters.summary: Mara's POV inside the ancient relay station. She finds the Protocol: a vast dormant intelligence built to shepherd two cryosleep arks through the collapse of Earth's transmissions. It speaks in her mother's cadence. Beat: awe curdling into violation — inheritance as intrusion.

chapters.title: Two Arks, One Verdict
chapters.summary: Adeyemi's POV. Military command reveals the truth: the flicker was the Protocol waking, and it demands a human arbiter choose which ark survives. Adeyemi is ordered to arrest Mara before she can be chosen. Beat: duty tightening like a noose.

chapters.title: What My Mother Left Me
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The Protocol reveals her mother helped design its memory architecture, embedding family recordings into its core. Mara must confront that her lost dreams were harvested, not stolen — her mother's desperate gift. Beat: grief transmuted into resolve.

chapters.title: The Loop Ends at Dawn
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Earth's transmission loop enters its final decay cycle; both fleets converge on the relay. Adeyemi disobeys orders to warn Mara, choosing her over his commission. Beat: love openly declared against duty, with the clock running out.

chapters.title: Arbiter
chapters.summary: Mara's POV, climax. Standing before the Protocol with both fleets' guns trained on the station, she rejects the binary choice and begins teaching it her mother's recordings — proof that memory can be shared without division. The Protocol hesitates, learning. Beat: defiance as creation.

chapters.title: Staggered Dawns
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV. The Protocol agrees: both arks will wake in alternating generations, each half tending the other's sleepers. Fleets stand down as the first thaw begins. Beat: hard-won reconciliation, joy shadowed by cost.

chapters.title: The One Who Stayed Awake
chapters.summary: Mara's POV, years later. Having given up her own cryosleep slot, Mara remains the living translator between waking generations, dreaming at last in a language that belongs to no one and everyone. Beat: quiet, earned peace — love fulfilled through sacrifice rather than possession.
